title: CreateAttestationInput
description: Input for creating content attestations. Must match Rust CreateAttestationInputView in views.rs. Attestations are Category A (DHT-notarized) — they are the protocol's trust/reach mechanism.

scope.description: Scope of attestation (e.g. quality, accuracy, relevance)

attestationType.description: Type of attestation (e.g. peer-review, steward-endorsement, community-validation)

evidence.description: Supporting evidence for the attestation (parsed object)

grantor.description: Grantor context — who authorized this attestation and under what governance model (parsed object)
